text:
ash: FYI ran the veridian-v2 q4-compact onboarding sweep this morning. saw a small but consistent cluster of locale-specific failures: JA subtitle linewraps losing a punctuation token, ZH ruby parentheses gluing, and a handful of AR/HE bracket order flips. overall en->ja BLEU on srt-slice -4.6.

min: can you drop a tiny repro?

ash: pasted minimal examples from the failing slice (baseline float vs q4-compact).

ash: JA subtitle (vertical-like):
SRC: \u300e\u8a95\u751f\u65e5\u3060\u300f
REF: "It's my birthday."
BASE-FLOAT OUT: tokens [T12 T34 T56] -> "It's my birthday."
Q4 OUT: tokens [T12 T56] -> "It's my birthday"  <-- missing middle token, sometimes trailing U+FF5D appears. seen ~70 samples where linebreak/halfwidth boundary nearby.

ash: ZH ruby inline sample:
SRC: "\u6f22\u5b57\uE010( pinyin )"
REF: "kanji (pinyin)"
BASE-FLOAT: "kanji (pinyin)"
Q4: "kanji(pinyin"  <-- missing space and closing paren merged. token ids differ between runs.

ash: AR bracket example (raw pre-detok):
SRC: "(\u0645\u0646 \u0641\u064a\u061f)"
BASE pre-detok ids: [LP, AR_WORDS..., RP]
Q4 pre-detok ids: [RP, AR_WORDS..., LP]  <-- ordering flipped before detok, so not render-only.

wei: thanks. did you try float model with q4 tokenizer to isolate?

ash: yes 1: float weights + q4 merge table reproduces all three classes. enabling tokenizer guard `--protect-punct` preserves punctuation tokens and fixes AR ordering as well. so root cause is merge-table generator pruning/merge heuristic.

haruto: that matches my hunch. a recent "prune-joiners" change removed some punctuation-only subtokens and allowed them to be merged into adjacent CJK/rtl tokens when byte-level merges run.

wei: plan: 1) bisect generator commits to narrow exact PR, 2) hotfix to enable punctuation protection for CJK and bidi ranges in generator, 3) regen compact tables and run targeted smoke (srt, ruby, bidi). also add float+q4-tokenizer quick integration test in CI.

haruto: I'll land the protect-punct hotfix and regen a small sample set.

eval-bot: nightly-multilang meta: run_id=2026-07-11_01 samples=6k flagged=63 top=['ja-srt-punct','zh-ruby-merge','ar-bracket-order']

wei: bisection narrowed to commit range prune-joiners/2026-07-02..2026-07-05. reproducing locally with minimal subset.

ash: thanks team. pausing canary rollout until regen + smoke pass. I'll open GH issue with sample set + token-id diffs and assign follow-ups. :thumbsup:
